districts.name: The Tailings
districts.blurb: A company town built on the ponds where the mine dumps what it can't sell. Everyone here works for Con-Reg, used to, or owes them.

clients.name: Marta Okafor
clients.title: the union steward
clients.blurb: Runs the night-shift local out of the back of the Last Whistle. Pays in cash and grudges.

clients.name: Dutch Abernathy
clients.title: the scrap dealer
clients.blurb: Owns the Cable Street yard and most of what's in it. Pays in parts, some of them his.

clients.name: Foreman Sully
clients.title: a company foreman
clients.blurb: Works for Con-Reg by day and for himself the rest of the time.

clients.name: Ma Prewitt
clients.title: your landlady
clients.blurb: Owns the hangar your ship sits in. Rent's due, but she'll take a favour.

clients.name: Rook
clients.title: a bookie at the Last Whistle
clients.blurb: Takes bets on shift quotas, cave-ins and you.

clients.name: Sister Agnes
clients.title: the mission kitchen
clients.blurb: Feeds half the Tailings on donations and the other half on what she can lift.

sites.name: Pit Nine
sites.blurb: An open cut gone quiet since the last cave-in. Quiet isn't empty.

sites.name: the Cable Street yard
sites.blurb: Dutch's scrapyard: a mile of dead machinery and a fence with opinions.

sites.name: Depot 4
sites.blurb: The Company's warehouse for everything it charges you for twice.

sites.name: the Last Whistle
sites.blurb: The shift bar. Watered beer, honest fights.

shop.name: Dutch's yard
shop.pitch: Dutch sells what the scavvers missed, and buys whatever you can carry in. Cash, no questions, no refunds.

districts.name: The Strand
districts.blurb: The spaceport's sailors' quarter, along the landing field's fence: chandlers, pawnshops, a mission and bars, all of them open when a Fleet ship is in.

clients.name: Nell Achebe
clients.title: your landlady
clients.blurb: Owns the dry dock your hull sits in. Asks no questions about crates, and charges for not asking.

clients.name: Hal Voss
clients.title: the ship's chandler
clients.blurb: Sells rope, rivets and rations to every ship that lands, and buys whatever falls off them.

clients.name: Storekeeper Dunne
clients.title: a Fleet storekeeper
clients.blurb: Signs for the Fleet's stores at the port, and signs some of them out again for cash.

clients.name: Mother Ilse
clients.title: the seamen's mission
clients.blurb: Runs the mission's soup and bunks, and hides deserters in the coal cellar for the love of God and a little rent.

clients.name: Big Gage
clients.title: the dockers' boss
clients.blurb: Runs the stevedores on the landing field. Nothing gets loaded without him, and nothing goes missing without him either.

clients.name: Linnet
clients.title: a pawnbroker
clients.blurb: Buys medals, sidearms and sad stories. Pays in cash, and in parts when the cash runs short.

sites.name: the breakers' yard
sites.blurb: Where old ships come apart for scrap. Some of the scrap is still arguing about it.

sites.name: Bonded Store 12
sites.blurb: The customs warehouse for cargo nobody has paid the duty on. Yet.

sites.name: the blast pits
sites.blurb: Terraced pits at the field's edge, cut for engine tests. Quiet between firings.

sites.name: the Brig
sites.blurb: The Strand's sailors' bar, named by someone with a sense of humor and a record.

shop.name: Voss's chandlery
shop.pitch: Voss sells what ships drop and sailors pawn: Fleet surplus, mostly, with the serial numbers filed off. Cash only.

districts.name: The Narrows
districts.blurb: The old town's back streets under the ore conveyors: clubs, lock-ups and stairways that go somewhere, if you know someone.

clients.name: Kit Marlowe
clients.title: your landlady
clients.blurb: Rents lock-ups to people who need a door that locks. Yours has a hull in it, and she's never asked how.

clients.name: Ferris
clients.title: a fence
clients.blurb: Buys anything that isn't nailed down, and sells the nails separately.

clients.name: Lena DaCosta
clients.title: the customs broker
clients.blurb: Gets cargo through customs for a fee, and customs officers through the week for another.

clients.name: Doc Haverty
clients.title: a back-room doctor
clients.blurb: Patches people up off the books. Struck off twice, and still the steadiest hands in the Narrows.

clients.name: Sal Pike
clients.title: the other family
clients.blurb: Runs the Pikes, who'd like the Hallorans' business, and don't mind using you to get it.

clients.name: Mags
clients.title: the Velvet's owner
clients.blurb: Owns the Narrows' one honest club. Honest about the watered drinks, anyway.

sites.name: Kettle's salvage
sites.blurb: A salvage yard that also handles insurance claims. The two businesses help each other.

sites.name: the customs pound
sites.blurb: Where customs keeps what it seizes, until it sells it back to the people it seized it from.

sites.name: the flooded quarry
sites.blurb: An old cut below the conveyors, half full of water and the things people drop in it.

sites.name: the Velvet
sites.blurb: Mags's club. Low lights, a loud band, back rooms.

shop.name: Ferris's back room
shop.pitch: Ferris sells what fell off other people's ships, and buys what falls off yours. No receipts.
